reason: I already get my gel nails done at the salon in SM Masinag while I'm out shopping anyway, and I like that setting and my suki nail tech. ₱1,800 is also more than I usually pay there, and for a new page on Messenger with no reviews I'm not going to try them out on my nails right before the wedding.
objection: I don't know this nail artist or how good the work really is. A portfolio on Facebook can be anyone's photos, and for my wedding nails I'd rather trust the tech who already knows my nails.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews or tagged photos from brides I know in Cainta, plus a group rate for the entourage so it's cheaper per person than the mall.
